title: Motion Planning for Robots

contract.reader: An engineer or student who knows the two-link arm and frames from Introduction to Robotics, basic linear algebra and calculus, and reads Python, deciding whether and where to start motion planning on ACRR
contract.problem: Knowing what the five entries cover, why in this order, what is out of scope and which conventions they share
contract.outcome: The reader knows the path from the abstract problem to the robot's wheels, where feedback comes from, what is excluded, the shared notation and five checkable objectives
contract.contribution: An order stated as the question a planner answers, from the most abstract statement to the robot's wheels, with each entry's role in one sentence
contract.evidence: The five entries (each statement checked against them in the 2026-10-24 live review)
contract.limitations: An overview; total reading time not stated

reviewers: series editor (independent agent; developmental, copy, series and cross-entry fact checks of the overview)

history.note: live review: accepted (editorial/live-reviews/series/motion-planning.md); library decision: retain
